title: Zverev Reaches the Top of Men's Tennis
summary: Alexander Zverev will become the men's world number one on Monday. He made sure of it by beating Tallon Griekspoor 6-4 7-5 at the Erste Bank Open in Vienna, reaching the quarter-finals. He will replace Jannik Sinner at the top. Zverev, 29, is the 30th man to become world number one. He is only the second German to do it, after Boris Becker in 1991. He has already made sure he will finish 2026 as the top player of the year. It has been a great year for him. He has won two Grand Slam titles and 64 of his 80 matches. At the start of the year, it seemed that only Sinner or Carlos Alcaraz could be number one. But injuries kept those two out for much of the season, and that opened the door for Zverev. He won the French Open and the US Open. Zverev said it had been a wait, but sometimes you have to wait for the best things in life. Next, he faces British number one Arthur Fery in the quarter-finals.
why_it_matters: It shows that keeping going and waiting for your chance can pay off, even when others seem ahead of you at the start.
